column1: The analysis excludes chart records dated 1 March 2025 due to unresolved duplicate chart snapshots.
Re-entry events spanning the excluded date require cautious interpretation.
Retention observations active at the end of the dataset are right-censored.
The fandom intensity score is a chart-based proxy and not a direct measurement of audience loyalty or behaviour.
The explicit-content statistical comparison includes only 19 explicit songs, limiting the strength and generalizability of the comparison.
Statistical tests identify associations and do not establish causal relationships.
Classification data has an imbalanced target distribution, which affects precision, recall and prediction reliability.
Classification and regression performance is evaluated on a chronological holdout period and may change on future chart observations.
The regression model relies heavily on current chart position, which is an important predictor of subsequent observed chart position.
The dataset does not provide direct streaming counts, listener demographics or social media engagement.
Feature importance describes predictive usefulness within the evaluated models and does not establish causation.
